# E2E pipeline. Products activate via repository Variables/Secrets:
#   Variables: <PRODUCT>_BASE_URL   Secrets: <PRODUCT>_TEST_EMAIL / _TEST_PASSWORD
# With none configured the run is a valid no-op (0 tests).
# For large suites, split a job with sharding:
#   run: npx playwright test --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/4
name: E2E

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npx playwright test
        env:
          FREELAND_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.FREELAND_BASE_URL }}
          FREELAND_TEST_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.FREELAND_TEST_EMAIL }}
          FREELAND_TEST_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.FREELAND_TEST_PASSWORD }}
          MAGICPAY_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.MAGICPAY_BASE_URL }}
          # Nuanu Flow CI is public/read-only: repository base-URL variable only.
          NUANUFLOW_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.NUANUFLOW_BASE_URL }}
          # Add your product's vars/secrets here.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30
